seo.title: Success Story - Why Focaccia Club equipped its 9 restaurants with Innovorder
seo.description: Jing Ren, founder of Focaccia Club, wants to position his restaurant chain as the leader in focaccia in France. He called on Innovorder to equip his restaurants.

fields.rt-blog-html:
Goal: to become France's leader in focaccia by 2024

Jing Ren, founder of Focaccia Club, makes no secret of the fact. He wants to position his restaurant chain as the leader in focaccia in France.

To achieve this ambitious goal, this ambitious entrepreneur draws on his retail experience to replicate a proven model.

His strategy is simple: develop a vast network of restaurants quickly, in a segment where there's plenty of room for growth.

With 9 outlets already in Paris, Jing doesn't waste a second. However, his project has been carefully thought through, and nothing has been left to chance.

‍"I chose premium locations, to capitalize on very good visibility, small surface areas and above all a quality product that appeals to everyone."

When it comes to branding, Focaccia Club doesn't do things by halves either. Its restaurants are so eye-catching that it's impossible to miss them in the Parisian landscape. Clashing white and pink storefronts, dark green floors. No doubt about it, this is Focaccia Club!

‍

‍

Surround yourself with the right people to succeed

That said, Jing, like thousands of restaurant entrepreneurs, faces many constraints in developing his network:

  • the current economic climate makes the future uncertain,
  • it has to cope with limited space so as not to undermine its profitability,
  • recruitment in the dining room and kitchen is time-consuming and complex, especially as he relies on a dynamic, smiling team to welcome his customers.

In fact, he makes it a point of honor to do so.

"This is the priority of our model: customers must be well served. In foodservice, 90% of business is done on the ground."

To ensure Focaccia Club's growth and achieve its objective, he is also convinced that mastery of its image, as well as mastery of the technical side, are essential.

"Once a first restaurant is open, once the concept is tried and tested, duplicating our model is inevitably easier and therefore faster."

For this reason, choosing reliable tools and partners is crucial.

‍

‍

The choice of a robust, all-in-one solution

In order to be able to concentrate on growing its business, Jing has turned to the most scalable solutions possible, whether for its cash register, scheduling or payroll solutions.

"Innovorder is present in all my outlets because it's a complete checkout system that's simple to use and easy to deploy."

As the head of a restaurant chain, he sees this as the main benefit of an ecosystem like Innovorder.

"With just a few clicks, my network manager pilots all my restaurants, checking product performance and profitability. We have a global vision thanks to the various reports."

‍

‍

What's next for Focaccia Club?

The first Innovorder ordering kiosks have appeared in selected outlets, and others may soon follow. The aim is to facilitate order-taking and increase the shopping basket through additional sales.

Meanwhile, Focaccia Club continues to grow.

"It's very reassuring to work with a serious structure that knows the terrain, understands my needs, and offers real after-sales service."

A further 10 restaurants are expected in the Paris region by the end of the year, and the network could open up to franchising in the provinces as early as 2024 once the concept has been fully mastered!

-

Thank you Jing for your confidence, the whole Innovorder team is proud to accompany you on this wonderful adventure 🙂
